133	def _validate_request(request: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
134	    if not isinstance(request, dict):
135	        raise ValueError("request must be an object")
136	    action = request.get("action")
137	    if not isinstance(action, str) or action not in _REQUEST_FIELDS:
138	        raise ValueError("request action is invalid")
139	    if set(request.keys()) != set(_REQUEST_FIELDS[action]):
140	        raise ValueError("request has invalid fields")
141	    job_id = request["job_id"]
142	    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
143	        raise ValueError("request job_id must be a non-empty string")
144	    at = request["at"]
145	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
146	        raise ValueError("request at must be a non-boolean non-negative "
147	                         "integer")
148	    normalized: dict[str, Any] = {"action": action, "job_id": job_id}
149	    if action in ("claim", "finish"):
150	        owner = request["owner"]
151	        if not isinstance(owner, str) or not owner:
152	            raise ValueError("request owner must be a non-empty string")
153	        normalized["owner"] = owner
154	    if action == "claim":
155	        lease = request["lease"]
156	        if not _is_plain_int(lease) or lease <= 0:
157	            raise ValueError("request lease must be a non-boolean "
158	                             "positive integer")
159	        normalized["lease"] = lease
160	    if action == "finish":
161	        result = request["result"]
162	        if result not in _RESULTS:
163	            raise ValueError("request result is invalid")
164	        normalized["result"] = result
165	    normalized["at"] = at
166	    return {field: normalized[field] for field in _REQUEST_FIELDS[action]}
167	
168	
169	def _validate_ledger(
170	    data: object,
171	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
172	           dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
173	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_ROOT_FIELDS):
174	        raise ValueError("dispatch ledger root must be an object with keys "
175	                         "version, decisions, idempotency and audit")
176	    version = data["version"]
177	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version != _VERSION:
178	        raise ValueError("unsupported dispatch ledger version")
179	
180	    decisions_raw = data["decisions"]
181	    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
182	    audit_raw = data["audit"]
183	    if not isinstance(decisions_raw, dict) \
184	            or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict) \
185	            or not isinstance(audit_raw, dict):
186	        raise ValueError("decisions, idempotency and audit must be objects")
187	    _check_sorted_keys(decisions_raw, "decisions")
188	    _check_sorted_keys(idempotency_raw, "idempotency")
189	    _check_sorted_keys(audit_raw, "audit")
190	
191	    decisions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
192	    for job_id, record in decisions_raw.items():
193	        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
194	            raise ValueError("decision job ids must be non-empty strings")
195	        decision = _validate_decision(record)
196	        if decision["job_id"] != job_id:
197	            raise ValueError("decision record id does not match its key")
198	        decisions[job_id] = decision
199	
200	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
201	    for key, request_raw in idempotency_raw.items():
202	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
203	            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
204	        request = _validate_request(request_raw)
205	        if request["job_id"] not in decisions:
206	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded "
207	                             "decision")
208	        idempotency[key] = request
209	
210	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
211	    for key, event_raw in audit_raw.items():
212	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
213	            raise ValueError("audit keys must be non-empty strings")
214	        if not isinstance(event_raw, dict) \
215	                or set(event_raw.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
216	            raise ValueError("dispatch audit event has invalid fields")
217	        if event_raw["key"] != key or not isinstance(event_raw["key"], str):
218	            raise ValueError("audit event key does not match its map key")
219	        request = _validate_request(event_raw["request"])
220	        result = _validate_decision(event_raw["result"])
221	        if request["job_id"] != result["job_id"]:
222	            raise ValueError("audit event result does not match its "
223	                             "request")
224	        events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request, "result": result}
225	
226	    # The three sections describe one dispatch history: each idempotency
227	    # key binds one request and one event, and the event carries exactly
228	    # the bound request.
229	    if set(idempotency) != set(events):
230	        raise ValueError("idempotency keys and audit events do not match")
231	    for key, request in idempotency.items():
232	        if events[key]["request"] != request:
233	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its idempotency "
234	                             "entry")
235	
236	    # A decision's job id, commit moment, traded resource version and
237	    # deadline never change after the commit; every recorded result
238	    # snapshot must agree with them, and each action's snapshot must
239	    # show exactly the state the action commits.
240	    commits: dict[str, str] = {}
241	    claims: dict[str, int] = {}
242	    for key, request in idempotency.items():
243	        job_id = request["job_id"]
244	        decision = decisions[job_id]
245	        result = events[key]["result"]
246	        for field in ("at", "resource_id", "version", "deadline"):
247	            if result[field] != decision[field]:
248	                raise ValueError("audit event result does not match its "
249	                                 "decision")
250	        action = request["action"]
251	        if action == "commit":
252	            if job_id in commits:
253	                raise ValueError("job committed under more than one "
254	                                 "idempotency key")
255	            commits[job_id] = key
256	            if result["at"] != request["at"] or result["state"] != "ready" \
257	                    or result["attempts"] != 0:
258	                raise ValueError("commit audit result must be a fresh "
259	                                 "ready decision")
260	        elif action == "claim":
261	            claims[job_id] = claims.get(job_id, 0) + 1
262	            if result["state"] != "claimed" \
263	                    or result["owner"] != request["owner"] \
264	                    or result["lease_end"] != request["at"] + request["lease"] \
265	                    or result["attempts"] < 1:
266	                raise ValueError("claim audit result does not match its "
267	                                 "request")
268	        elif action == "finish":
269	            if result["state"] != request["result"]:
270	                raise ValueError("finish audit result does not match its "
271	                                 "request")
272	        else:  # recover
273	            if result["state"] != "ready":
274	                raise ValueError("recover audit result must be a ready "
275	                                 "decision")
276	    if set(commits) != set(decisions):
277	        raise ValueError("every decision must be bound to a commit "
278	                         "request")
279	    # Claims are the only calls that count attempts.
280	    for job_id, decision in decisions.items():
281	        if decision["attempts"] != claims.get(job_id, 0):
282	            raise ValueError("decision attempts do not match the claim "
283	                             "history")
284	
285	    return decisions, idempotency, events

393	def commit(
394	    jobs: str,
395	    supply: str,
396	    trades: str,
397	    ledger: str,
398	    job_id: str,
399	    key: str,
400	    at: int,
401	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
402	    """Create the dispatch decision for one traded job idempotently.
403	
404	    ``jobs``, ``supply``, ``trades`` and ``ledger`` paths, ``job_id``
405	    and ``key`` must be non-empty strings and ``at`` a non-boolean
406	    non-negative integer evaluation moment; the four paths must also
407	    resolve to distinct real locations. Any violation raises
408	    ``ValueError`` before a business file is read.
409	
410	    The ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file, the resource supply file and
411	    the ``market.clear`` clearing ledger are read as one snapshot under
412	    their shared locks together with the dispatch ledger's exclusive
413	    lock, all four taken in resolved real-path order so concurrent
414	    calls can never deadlock. The decision binds the job id, the
415	    commit moment, the traded resource id and version and the job's
416	    deadline; it starts in state ``ready`` with zero attempts and no
417	    owner or lease. A commit moment later than the job's deadline
418	    raises ``TimeoutError``.
419	
420	    Returns ``(decision, created)``. A missing dispatch ledger is
421	    created only by this call, the decision, its idempotency binding
422	    and the audit event -- the complete request plus the committed
423	    decision snapshot -- in one synced atomic write. Replaying the same
424	    key with the same job and moment returns the current decision with
425	    ``False`` without rewriting; the same key with a different action,
426	    job or moment, or a job already committed under another key, raises
427	    ``ValueError`` with the ledger untouched.
428	
429	    An unknown job raises ``KeyError`` and a job without a recorded
430	    trade raises ``LookupError``; neither creates the ledger. Missing
431	    input files or a missing ledger parent raise
432	    ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid structure, values, ordering,
433	    references or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other locking,
434	    read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
435	    """
436	    for value in (jobs, supply, trades, ledger, job_id, key):
437	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
438	            raise ValueError("jobs, supply, trades, ledger, job_id and key "
439	                             "must be non-empty strings")
440	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
441	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
442	
443	    job_real = os.path.realpath(jobs)
444	    supply_real = os.path.realpath(supply)
445	    trades_real = os.path.realpath(trades)
446	    ledger_real = os.path.realpath(ledger)
447	    business_reals = {job_real, supply_real, trades_real, ledger_real}
448	    if len(business_reals) != 4:
449	        raise ValueError("jobs, supply, trades and ledger paths must be "
450	                         "distinct real paths")
451	    # Completion ledgers beside the snapshots are part of the trades
452	    # ledger's capacity envelope; they are discovered before locking and
453	    # shared in the same global order so a concurrent completion can
454	    # never deadlock against this commit.
455	    completion_reals = set(
456	        _market._discover_completion_paths(tuple(business_reals)))
457	
458	    store = _get_store(ledger)
459	    with store.lock:
460	        # Locks are taken in one resolved-real-path order shared by
461	        # every caller, so concurrent commits can never deadlock; the
462	        # dispatch ledger lock is exclusive, the input snapshots shared.
463	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
464	            for locked in sorted(business_reals | completion_reals):
465	                stack.enter_context(
466	                    _lock(locked, shared=(locked != ledger_real)))
467	
468	            accepted, job_map, job_events, job_raw = \
469	                _jobs._load_submit_file(job_real)
470	            if job_raw is None:
471	                raise FileNotFoundError(
472	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
473	            # Like the supply file and the ledgers, the acceptance
474	            # snapshot must be in the canonical compact form
475	            # jobs.submit writes.
476	            if job_raw != _jobs._serialize_submit_file(
477	                    accepted, job_map, job_events):
478	                raise ValueError(
479	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} is not in canonical "
480	                    "compact form")
481	            history, _supply_map, _supply_events, supply_raw = \
482	                _resources._load_file(supply_real)
483	            if supply_raw is None:
484	                raise FileNotFoundError(
485	                    f"supply file {supply_real!r} does not exist")
486	            cleared, _clear_keys, trades_raw = _market._load_clear_ledger(
487	                trades_real, accepted, history,
488	                completion_paths=sorted(completion_reals))
489	            if trades_raw is None:
490	                raise FileNotFoundError(
491	                    f"clearing ledger {trades_real!r} does not exist")
492	            decisions, idempotency, events, old_bytes = _load_ledger(
493	                ledger_real)
494	
495	            request = _request("commit", job_id, at)
496	            replayed = _replay(decisions, idempotency, key, request)
497	            if replayed is not None:
498	                return replayed
499	
500	            job = accepted.get(job_id)
501	            if job is None:
502	                raise KeyError(job_id)
503	            if job_id in decisions:
504	                raise ValueError("job is already committed under another "
505	                                 "idempotency key")
506	            trade = cleared.get(job_id)
507	            if trade is None:
508	                raise LookupError("job has no recorded trade")
509	            deadline = job["deadline"]
510	            if at > deadline:
511	                raise TimeoutError("commit moment exceeds the job "
512	                                   "deadline")
513	
514	            decision: dict[str, Any] = {
515	                "job_id": job_id,
516	                "at": at,
517	                "resource_id": trade["resource_id"],
518	                "version": trade["version"],
519	                "deadline": deadline,
520	                "state": "ready",
521	                "attempts": 0,
522	                "owner": None,
523	                "lease_end": None,
524	            }
525	            decisions[job_id] = decision
526	            idempotency[key] = request
527	            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request,
528	                           "result": copy.deepcopy(decision)}
529	            _commit_file(ledger_real,
530	                         _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events),
531	                         old_bytes)
532	            return copy.deepcopy(decision), True

535	def claim(
536	    ledger: str,
537	    job_id: str,
538	    key: str,
539	    owner: str,
540	    lease: int,
541	    at: int,
542	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
543	    """Claim a ready or failed decision for one owner idempotently.
544	
545	    ``ledger``, ``job_id``, ``key`` and ``owner`` must be non-empty
546	    strings, ``lease`` a non-boolean positive integer and ``at`` a
547	    non-boolean non-negative integer current moment, else
548	    ``ValueError``. Only the dispatch ledger is touched, under its
549	    exclusive lock.
550	
551	    A successful claim moves the decision to ``claimed``, counts one
552	    more attempt and records the owner with a lease ending at
553	    ``at + lease``; a lease end later than the job's deadline raises
554	    ``TimeoutError``. A decision still claimed under a valid lease
555	    raises ``TimeoutError`` as well, one whose lease has expired must
556	    be recovered first and a finished one cannot be claimed -- both
557	    raise ``ValueError``. Returns ``(decision, created)``; replaying
558	    the same key with the same job, owner, lease and moment returns the
559	    current decision with ``False`` without writing, while the same key
560	    with a different action, job, owner, moment or lease raises
561	    ``ValueError``.
562	
563	    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; a missing dispatch ledger
564	    raises ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid ledger structure, values,
565	    ordering, references or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
566	    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
567	    """
568	    for value in (ledger, job_id, key, owner):
569	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
570	            raise ValueError("ledger, job_id, key and owner must be "
571	                             "non-empty strings")
572	    if not _is_plain_int(lease) or lease <= 0:
573	        raise ValueError("lease must be a non-boolean positive integer")
574	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
575	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
576	
577	    store = _get_store(ledger)
578	    with store.lock:
579	        with _lock(store.realpath):
580	            decisions, idempotency, events, old_bytes = \
581	                _load_existing_ledger(store.realpath)
582	
583	            request = _request("claim", job_id, at, owner=owner,
584	                               lease=lease)
585	            replayed = _replay(decisions, idempotency, key, request)
586	            if replayed is not None:
587	                return replayed
588	
589	            decision = decisions.get(job_id)
590	            if decision is None:
591	                raise KeyError(job_id)
592	            state = decision["state"]
593	            if state == "claimed":
594	                if at <= decision["lease_end"]:
595	                    raise TimeoutError("decision is claimed under a "
596	                                       "valid lease")
597	                raise ValueError("decision is claimed under an expired "
598	                                 "lease and must be recovered first")
599	            if state not in ("ready", "failed"):
600	                raise ValueError("decision state does not accept a claim")
601	            lease_end = at + lease
602	            if lease_end > decision["deadline"]:
603	                raise TimeoutError("lease end exceeds the job deadline")
604	
605	            decision["state"] = "claimed"
606	            decision["attempts"] += 1
607	            decision["owner"] = owner
608	            decision["lease_end"] = lease_end
609	            idempotency[key] = request
610	            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request,
611	                           "result": copy.deepcopy(decision)}
612	            _commit_file(store.realpath,
613	                         _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events),
614	                         old_bytes)
615	            return copy.deepcopy(decision), True
616

618	def finish(
619	    ledger: str,
620	    job_id: str,
621	    key: str,
622	    owner: str,
623	    result: str,
624	    at: int,
625	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
626	    """Finish a claimed decision with ``succeeded`` or ``failed``.
627	
628	    ``ledger``, ``job_id``, ``key`` and ``owner`` must be non-empty
629	    strings, ``result`` exactly ``succeeded`` or ``failed`` and ``at``
630	    a non-boolean non-negative integer current moment, else
631	    ``ValueError``. Only the dispatch ledger is touched, under its
632	    exclusive lock.
633	
634	    Only the current owner acting inside its lease may finish: a
635	    decision that is not claimed raises ``ValueError``, a different
636	    owner raises ``PermissionError`` and a moment later than the lease
637	    end raises ``TimeoutError``. A successful finish records the result
638	    as the new state and clears the owner and the lease; the attempt
639	    count is unchanged. Returns ``(decision, created)``; replaying the
640	    same key with the same job, owner, result and moment returns the
641	    current decision with ``False`` without writing, while the same key
642	    with a different action, job, owner, result or moment raises
643	    ``ValueError``.
644	
645	    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; a missing dispatch ledger
646	    raises ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid ledger structure, values,
647	    ordering, references or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
648	    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
649	    """
650	    for value in (ledger, job_id, key, owner):
651	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
652	            raise ValueError("ledger, job_id, key and owner must be "
653	                             "non-empty strings")
654	    if result not in _RESULTS:
655	        raise ValueError("result must be succeeded or failed")
656	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
657	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
658	
659	    store = _get_store(ledger)
660	    with store.lock:
661	        with _lock(store.realpath):
662	            decisions, idempotency, events, old_bytes = \
663	                _load_existing_ledger(store.realpath)
664	
665	            request = _request("finish", job_id, at, owner=owner,
666	                               result=result)
667	            replayed = _replay(decisions, idempotency, key, request)
668	            if replayed is not None:
669	                return replayed
670	
671	            decision = decisions.get(job_id)
672	            if decision is None:
673	                raise KeyError(job_id)
674	            if decision["state"] != "claimed":
675	                raise ValueError("decision is not claimed")
676	            if decision["owner"] != owner:
677	                raise PermissionError("finish requires the current owner")
678	            if at > decision["lease_end"]:
679	                raise TimeoutError("the lease has already expired")
680	
681	            decision["state"] = result
682	            decision["owner"] = None
683	            decision["lease_end"] = None
684	            idempotency[key] = request
685	            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request,
686	                           "result": copy.deepcopy(decision)}
687	            _commit_file(store.realpath,
688	                         _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events),
689	                         old_bytes)
690	            return copy.deepcopy(decision), True

"""Persistent dispatch commitments over ``market.clear`` trades.

One on-disk document (version 1), the dispatch ledger, holds the whole
dispatch layer on top of the clearing ledger:

* ``decisions`` maps each job id to its scheduling decision, binding the
  traded resource version and the job deadline, with a lifecycle state
  (``ready``, ``claimed``, ``succeeded`` or ``failed``), an attempt
  counter and, while claimed, the owner and the lease end;
* ``idempotency`` binds each call key to the complete request it first
  served (action, job id and moment, plus owner, lease or result where
  the action carries them);
* ``audit`` holds one event per first-served key, binding the complete
  request and the decision snapshot the call committed.

:func:`commit` reads the ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file, the resource
supply file and the ``market.clear`` clearing ledger as one snapshot
under their shared locks together with the dispatch ledger's exclusive
lock, all four taken in resolved real-path order, and creates the
decision for one traded job in state ``ready`` with zero attempts.
:func:`claim`, :func:`finish` and :func:`recover` only touch the
dispatch ledger under its exclusive lock: claiming moves a ``ready`` or
``failed`` decision to ``claimed`` with one more attempt and a lease
that never passes the job deadline, finishing lets the current owner
inside its lease record ``succeeded`` or ``failed`` and clears owner
and lease, and recovering returns a decision whose lease has strictly
expired to ``ready`` without counting an attempt. The dispatch ledger
is created only by the first commit; every other call facing a missing
ledger fails with ``FileNotFoundError``.

Every read requires the on-disk bytes to be exactly the canonical
compact form :func:`_canonical_bytes` produces -- sections in their
fixed order, primary keys sorted by code point, compact UTF-8 JSON with
non-ASCII written through, no negative-zero or non-finite number
literals and exactly one trailing newline.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import copy
import json
import os
from typing import Any

from . import _lifecycle
from . import jobs as _jobs
from . import market as _market
from . import resources as _resources

__all__ = ["commit", "claim", "finish", "recover"]

_VERSION = 1
_ROOT_FIELDS = ("version", "decisions", "idempotency", "audit")
_DECISION_FIELDS = ("job_id", "at", "resource_id", "version", "deadline",
                    "state", "attempts", "owner", "lease_end")
_STATES = ("ready", "claimed", "succeeded", "failed")
_RESULTS = ("succeeded", "failed")
_EVENT_FIELDS = ("key", "request", "result")
_REQUEST_FIELDS = {
    "commit": ("action", "job_id", "at"),
    "claim": ("action", "job_id", "owner", "lease", "at"),
    "finish": ("action", "job_id", "owner", "result", "at"),
    "recover": ("action", "job_id", "at"),
}

# The in-process mutex registry, the companion flock, the small input
# checks and the synced atomic commit live in the shared lifecycle
# infrastructure; the names are kept as the module's own seams.
_Store = _lifecycle.Store
_get_store = _lifecycle.get_store
_is_plain_int = _lifecycle.is_plain_int
_check_sorted_keys = _lifecycle.check_sorted_keys
_lock = _lifecycle.file_lock


def _validate_decision(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(record, dict) \
            or set(record.keys()) != set(_DECISION_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("decision record has invalid fields")
    job_id = record["job_id"]
    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
        raise ValueError("decision job_id must be a non-empty string")
    at = record["at"]
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("decision at must be a non-boolean non-negative "
                         "integer")
    resource_id = record["resource_id"]
    if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
        raise ValueError("decision resource_id must be a non-empty string")
    version = record["version"]
    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version < 1:
        raise ValueError("decision version must be a positive integer")
    deadline = record["deadline"]
    if not _is_plain_int(deadline) or deadline < 0:
        raise ValueError("decision deadline must be a non-boolean "
                         "non-negative integer")
    state = record["state"]
    if state not in _STATES:
        raise ValueError("decision state is invalid")
    attempts = record["attempts"]
    if not _is_plain_int(attempts) or attempts < 0:
        raise ValueError("decision attempts must be a non-boolean "
                         "non-negative integer")
    owner = record["owner"]
    lease_end = record["lease_end"]
    if state == "claimed":
        if not isinstance(owner, str) or not owner:
            raise ValueError("claimed decision must carry a non-empty "
                             "owner")
        if not _is_plain_int(lease_end) or lease_end < 1:
            raise ValueError("claimed decision must carry a positive "
                             "lease end")
        if lease_end > deadline:
            raise ValueError("decision lease end must not pass the job "
                             "deadline")
    elif owner is not None or lease_end is not None:
        raise ValueError("an unclaimed decision must not carry an owner "
                         "or a lease")
    return {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "at": at,
        "resource_id": resource_id,
        "version": version,
        "deadline": deadline,
        "state": state,
        "attempts": attempts,
        "owner": owner,
        "lease_end": lease_end,
    }


def _validate_request(request: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(request, dict):
        raise ValueError("request must be an object")
    action = request.get("action")
    if not isinstance(action, str) or action not in _REQUEST_FIELDS:
        raise ValueError("request action is invalid")
    if set(request.keys()) != set(_REQUEST_FIELDS[action]):
        raise ValueError("request has invalid fields")
    job_id = request["job_id"]
    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
        raise ValueError("request job_id must be a non-empty string")
    at = request["at"]
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("request at must be a non-boolean non-negative "
                         "integer")
    normalized: dict[str, Any] = {"action": action, "job_id": job_id}
    if action in ("claim", "finish"):
        owner = request["owner"]
        if not isinstance(owner, str) or not owner:
            raise ValueError("request owner must be a non-empty string")
        normalized["owner"] = owner
    if action == "claim":
        lease = request["lease"]
        if not _is_plain_int(lease) or lease <= 0:
            raise ValueError("request lease must be a non-boolean "
                             "positive integer")
        normalized["lease"] = lease
    if action == "finish":
        result = request["result"]
        if result not in _RESULTS:
            raise ValueError("request result is invalid")
        normalized["result"] = result
    normalized["at"] = at
    return {field: normalized[field] for field in _REQUEST_FIELDS[action]}


def _validate_ledger(
    data: object,
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
           dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_ROOT_FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("dispatch ledger root must be an object with keys "
                         "version, decisions, idempotency and audit")
    version = data["version"]
    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version != _VERSION:
        raise ValueError("unsupported dispatch ledger version")

    decisions_raw = data["decisions"]
    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
    audit_raw = data["audit"]
    if not isinstance(decisions_raw, dict) \
            or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict) \
            or not isinstance(audit_raw, dict):
        raise ValueError("decisions, idempotency and audit must be objects")
    _check_sorted_keys(decisions_raw, "decisions")
    _check_sorted_keys(idempotency_raw, "idempotency")
    _check_sorted_keys(audit_raw, "audit")

    decisions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for job_id, record in decisions_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
            raise ValueError("decision job ids must be non-empty strings")
        decision = _validate_decision(record)
        if decision["job_id"] != job_id:
            raise ValueError("decision record id does not match its key")
        decisions[job_id] = decision

    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for key, request_raw in idempotency_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
        request = _validate_request(request_raw)
        if request["job_id"] not in decisions:
            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded "
                             "decision")
        idempotency[key] = request

    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for key, event_raw in audit_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError("audit keys must be non-empty strings")
        if not isinstance(event_raw, dict) \
                or set(event_raw.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
            raise ValueError("dispatch audit event has invalid fields")
        if event_raw["key"] != key or not isinstance(event_raw["key"], str):
            raise ValueError("audit event key does not match its map key")
        request = _validate_request(event_raw["request"])
        result = _validate_decision(event_raw["result"])
        if request["job_id"] != result["job_id"]:
            raise ValueError("audit event result does not match its "
                             "request")
        events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request, "result": result}

    # The three sections describe one dispatch history: each idempotency
    # key binds one request and one event, and the event carries exactly
    # the bound request.
    if set(idempotency) != set(events):
        raise ValueError("idempotency keys and audit events do not match")
    for key, request in idempotency.items():
        if events[key]["request"] != request:
            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its idempotency "
                             "entry")

    # A decision's job id, commit moment, traded resource version and
    # deadline never change after the commit; every recorded result
    # snapshot must agree with them, and each action's snapshot must
    # show exactly the state the action commits.
    commits: dict[str, str] = {}
    claims: dict[str, int] = {}
    for key, request in idempotency.items():
        job_id = request["job_id"]
        decision = decisions[job_id]
        result = events[key]["result"]
        for field in ("at", "resource_id", "version", "deadline"):
            if result[field] != decision[field]:
                raise ValueError("audit event result does not match its "
                                 "decision")
        action = request["action"]
        if action == "commit":
            if job_id in commits:
                raise ValueError("job committed under more than one "
                                 "idempotency key")
            commits[job_id] = key
            if result["at"] != request["at"] or result["state"] != "ready" \
                    or result["attempts"] != 0:
                raise ValueError("commit audit result must be a fresh "
                                 "ready decision")
        elif action == "claim":
            claims[job_id] = claims.get(job_id, 0) + 1
            if result["state"] != "claimed" \
                    or result["owner"] != request["owner"] \
                    or result["lease_end"] != request["at"] + request["lease"] \
                    or result["attempts"] < 1:
                raise ValueError("claim audit result does not match its "
                                 "request")
        elif action == "finish":
            if result["state"] != request["result"]:
                raise ValueError("finish audit result does not match its "
                                 "request")
        else:  # recover
            if result["state"] != "ready":
                raise ValueError("recover audit result must be a ready "
                                 "decision")
    if set(commits) != set(decisions):
        raise ValueError("every decision must be bound to a commit "
                         "request")
    # Claims are the only calls that count attempts.
    for job_id, decision in decisions.items():
        if decision["attempts"] != claims.get(job_id, 0):
            raise ValueError("decision attempts do not match the claim "
                             "history")

    return decisions, idempotency, events


def _canonical_bytes(
    decisions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> bytes:
    # Compact UTF-8 JSON, non-ASCII written through, sections in their
    # fixed field order and each section's primary keys in code-point
    # order, terminated by exactly one newline.
    payload = {
        "version": _VERSION,
        "decisions": {job_id: decisions[job_id]
                      for job_id in sorted(decisions)},
        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key] for key in sorted(idempotency)},
        "audit": {key: events[key] for key in sorted(events)},
    }
    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
                      allow_nan=False) + "\n"
    return text.encode("utf-8")


def _canonical_sections(
    sections: tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
                    dict[str, dict[str, Any]]],
) -> bytes:
    decisions, idempotency, events = sections
    return _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events)


def _load_ledger(
    realpath: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
           dict[str, dict[str, Any]], bytes | None]:
    sections, raw = _lifecycle.load_canonical(
        realpath, "dispatch ledger", _validate_ledger,
        _canonical_sections)
    if sections is None:
        return {}, {}, {}, None
    decisions, idempotency, events = sections
    return decisions, idempotency, events, raw


def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
    _lifecycle.fsync_directory(directory)


def _rollback_file(realpath: str, directory: str, old_bytes: bytes | None,
                   first: BaseException) -> None:
    _lifecycle.rollback_file(realpath, directory, old_bytes, first,
                             prefix=".dispatch-restore-",
                             fsync_dir=_fsync_directory)


def _commit_file(realpath: str, payload: bytes,
                 old_bytes: bytes | None) -> None:
    # One durable commit for the decision, the idempotency binding and
    # the audit event: synced same-directory temporary, atomic replace
    # and a directory fsync, restoring the pre-call bytes on any
    # failure.
    _lifecycle.commit_file(realpath, payload, old_bytes,
                           prefix=".dispatch-", fsync_dir=_fsync_directory)


def _request(action: str, job_id: str, at: int, owner: str | None = None,
             lease: int | None = None, result: str | None = None
             ) -> dict[str, Any]:
    request: dict[str, Any] = {"action": action, "job_id": job_id}
    if action in ("claim", "finish"):
        request["owner"] = owner
    if action == "claim":
        request["lease"] = lease
    if action == "finish":
        request["result"] = result
    request["at"] = at
    return request


def _load_existing_ledger(
    realpath: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
           dict[str, dict[str, Any]], bytes]:
    decisions, idempotency, events, raw = _load_ledger(realpath)
    if raw is None:
        # Only the first commit creates the dispatch ledger; every other
        # action fails directly when it is missing.
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"dispatch ledger {realpath!r} does not exist")
    return decisions, idempotency, events, raw


def _replay(
    decisions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    key: str,
    request: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bool] | None:
    binding = idempotency.get(key)
    if binding is None:
        return None
    if binding != request:
        raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used with a "
                         "different request")
    # An equivalent replay returns the current record without writing.
    return copy.deepcopy(decisions[request["job_id"]]), False


def commit(
    jobs: str,
    supply: str,
    trades: str,
    ledger: str,
    job_id: str,
    key: str,
    at: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
    """Create the dispatch decision for one traded job idempotently.

    ``jobs``, ``supply``, ``trades`` and ``ledger`` paths, ``job_id``
    and ``key`` must be non-empty strings and ``at`` a non-boolean
    non-negative integer evaluation moment; the four paths must also
    resolve to distinct real locations. Any violation raises
    ``ValueError`` before a business file is read.

    The ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file, the resource supply file and
    the ``market.clear`` clearing ledger are read as one snapshot under
    their shared locks together with the dispatch ledger's exclusive
    lock, all four taken in resolved real-path order so concurrent
    calls can never deadlock. The decision binds the job id, the
    commit moment, the traded resource id and version and the job's
    deadline; it starts in state ``ready`` with zero attempts and no
    owner or lease. A commit moment later than the job's deadline
    raises ``TimeoutError``.

    Returns ``(decision, created)``. A missing dispatch ledger is
    created only by this call, the decision, its idempotency binding
    and the audit event -- the complete request plus the committed
    decision snapshot -- in one synced atomic write. Replaying the same
    key with the same job and moment returns the current decision with
    ``False`` without rewriting; the same key with a different action,
    job or moment, or a job already committed under another key, raises
    ``ValueError`` with the ledger untouched.

    An unknown job raises ``KeyError`` and a job without a recorded
    trade raises ``LookupError``; neither creates the ledger. Missing
    input files or a missing ledger parent raise
    ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid structure, values, ordering,
    references or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other locking,
    read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
    """
    for value in (jobs, supply, trades, ledger, job_id, key):
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
            raise ValueError("jobs, supply, trades, ledger, job_id and key "
                             "must be non-empty strings")
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")

    job_real = os.path.realpath(jobs)
    supply_real = os.path.realpath(supply)
    trades_real = os.path.realpath(trades)
    ledger_real = os.path.realpath(ledger)
    business_reals = {job_real, supply_real, trades_real, ledger_real}
    if len(business_reals) != 4:
        raise ValueError("jobs, supply, trades and ledger paths must be "
                         "distinct real paths")
    # Completion ledgers beside the snapshots are part of the trades
    # ledger's capacity envelope; they are discovered before locking and
    # shared in the same global order so a concurrent completion can
    # never deadlock against this commit.
    completion_reals = set(
        _market._discover_completion_paths(tuple(business_reals)))

    store = _get_store(ledger)
    with store.lock:
        # Locks are taken in one resolved-real-path order shared by
        # every caller, so concurrent commits can never deadlock; the
        # dispatch ledger lock is exclusive, the input snapshots shared.
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            for locked in sorted(business_reals | completion_reals):
                stack.enter_context(
                    _lock(locked, shared=(locked != ledger_real)))

            accepted, job_map, job_events, job_raw = \
                _jobs._load_submit_file(job_real)
            if job_raw is None:
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
            # Like the supply file and the ledgers, the acceptance
            # snapshot must be in the canonical compact form
            # jobs.submit writes.
            if job_raw != _jobs._serialize_submit_file(
                    accepted, job_map, job_events):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} is not in canonical "
                    "compact form")
            history, _supply_map, _supply_events, supply_raw = \
                _resources._load_file(supply_real)
            if supply_raw is None:
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    f"supply file {supply_real!r} does not exist")
            cleared, _clear_keys, trades_raw = _market._load_clear_ledger(
                trades_real, accepted, history,
                completion_paths=sorted(completion_reals))
            if trades_raw is None:
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    f"clearing ledger {trades_real!r} does not exist")
            decisions, idempotency, events, old_bytes = _load_ledger(
                ledger_real)

            request = _request("commit", job_id, at)
            replayed = _replay(decisions, idempotency, key, request)
            if replayed is not None:
                return replayed

            job = accepted.get(job_id)
            if job is None:
                raise KeyError(job_id)
            if job_id in decisions:
                raise ValueError("job is already committed under another "
                                 "idempotency key")
            trade = cleared.get(job_id)
            if trade is None:
                raise LookupError("job has no recorded trade")
            deadline = job["deadline"]
            if at > deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("commit moment exceeds the job "
                                   "deadline")

            decision: dict[str, Any] = {
                "job_id": job_id,
                "at": at,
                "resource_id": trade["resource_id"],
                "version": trade["version"],
                "deadline": deadline,
                "state": "ready",
                "attempts": 0,
                "owner": None,
                "lease_end": None,
            }
            decisions[job_id] = decision
            idempotency[key] = request
            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request,
                           "result": copy.deepcopy(decision)}
            _commit_file(ledger_real,
                         _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events),
                         old_bytes)
            return copy.deepcopy(decision), True


def claim(
    ledger: str,
    job_id: str,
    key: str,
    owner: str,
    lease: int,
    at: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
    """Claim a ready or failed decision for one owner idempotently.

    ``ledger``, ``job_id``, ``key`` and ``owner`` must be non-empty
    strings, ``lease`` a non-boolean positive integer and ``at`` a
    non-boolean non-negative integer current moment, else
    ``ValueError``. Only the dispatch ledger is touched, under its
    exclusive lock.

    A successful claim moves the decision to ``claimed``, counts one
    more attempt and records the owner with a lease ending at
    ``at + lease``; a lease end later than the job's deadline raises
    ``TimeoutError``. A decision still claimed under a valid lease
    raises ``TimeoutError`` as well, one whose lease has expired must
    be recovered first and a finished one cannot be claimed -- both
    raise ``ValueError``. Returns ``(decision, created)``; replaying
    the same key with the same job, owner, lease and moment returns the
    current decision with ``False`` without writing, while the same key
    with a different action, job, owner, moment or lease raises
    ``ValueError``.

    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; a missing dispatch ledger
    raises ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid ledger structure, values,
    ordering, references or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
    """
    for value in (ledger, job_id, key, owner):
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
            raise ValueError("ledger, job_id, key and owner must be "
                             "non-empty strings")
    if not _is_plain_int(lease) or lease <= 0:
        raise ValueError("lease must be a non-boolean positive integer")
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")

    store = _get_store(ledger)
    with store.lock:
        with _lock(store.realpath):
            decisions, idempotency, events, old_bytes = \
                _load_existing_ledger(store.realpath)

            request = _request("claim", job_id, at, owner=owner,
                               lease=lease)
            replayed = _replay(decisions, idempotency, key, request)
            if replayed is not None:
                return replayed

            decision = decisions.get(job_id)
            if decision is None:
                raise KeyError(job_id)
            state = decision["state"]
            if state == "claimed":
                if at <= decision["lease_end"]:
                    raise TimeoutError("decision is claimed under a "
                                       "valid lease")
                raise ValueError("decision is claimed under an expired "
                                 "lease and must be recovered first")
            if state not in ("ready", "failed"):
                raise ValueError("decision state does not accept a claim")
            lease_end = at + lease
            if lease_end > decision["deadline"]:
                raise TimeoutError("lease end exceeds the job deadline")

            decision["state"] = "claimed"
            decision["attempts"] += 1
            decision["owner"] = owner
            decision["lease_end"] = lease_end
            idempotency[key] = request
            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request,
                           "result": copy.deepcopy(decision)}
            _commit_file(store.realpath,
                         _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events),
                         old_bytes)
            return copy.deepcopy(decision), True


def finish(
    ledger: str,
    job_id: str,
    key: str,
    owner: str,
    result: str,
    at: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
    """Finish a claimed decision with ``succeeded`` or ``failed``.

    ``ledger``, ``job_id``, ``key`` and ``owner`` must be non-empty
    strings, ``result`` exactly ``succeeded`` or ``failed`` and ``at``
    a non-boolean non-negative integer current moment, else
    ``ValueError``. Only the dispatch ledger is touched, under its
    exclusive lock.

    Only the current owner acting inside its lease may finish: a
    decision that is not claimed raises ``ValueError``, a different
    owner raises ``PermissionError`` and a moment later than the lease
    end raises ``TimeoutError``. A successful finish records the result
    as the new state and clears the owner and the lease; the attempt
    count is unchanged. Returns ``(decision, created)``; replaying the
    same key with the same job, owner, result and moment returns the
    current decision with ``False`` without writing, while the same key
    with a different action, job, owner, result or moment raises
    ``ValueError``.

    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; a missing dispatch ledger
    raises ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid ledger structure, values,
    ordering, references or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
    """
    for value in (ledger, job_id, key, owner):
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
            raise ValueError("ledger, job_id, key and owner must be "
                             "non-empty strings")
    if result not in _RESULTS:
        raise ValueError("result must be succeeded or failed")
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")

    store = _get_store(ledger)
    with store.lock:
        with _lock(store.realpath):
            decisions, idempotency, events, old_bytes = \
                _load_existing_ledger(store.realpath)

            request = _request("finish", job_id, at, owner=owner,
                               result=result)
            replayed = _replay(decisions, idempotency, key, request)
            if replayed is not None:
                return replayed

            decision = decisions.get(job_id)
            if decision is None:
                raise KeyError(job_id)
            if decision["state"] != "claimed":
                raise ValueError("decision is not claimed")
            if decision["owner"] != owner:
                raise PermissionError("finish requires the current owner")
            if at > decision["lease_end"]:
                raise TimeoutError("the lease has already expired")

            decision["state"] = result
            decision["owner"] = None
            decision["lease_end"] = None
            idempotency[key] = request
            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request,
                           "result": copy.deepcopy(decision)}
            _commit_file(store.realpath,
                         _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events),
                         old_bytes)
            return copy.deepcopy(decision), True


def recover(
    ledger: str,
    job_id: str,
    key: str,
    at: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
    """Recover a claimed decision whose lease has strictly expired.

    ``ledger``, ``job_id`` and ``key`` must be non-empty strings and
    ``at`` a non-boolean non-negative integer current moment, else
    ``ValueError``. Only the dispatch ledger is touched, under its
    exclusive lock.

    A decision that is not claimed raises ``ValueError``; one whose
    lease has not strictly expired yet raises ``PermissionError``. A
    successful recovery returns the decision to ``ready`` and clears
    the owner and the lease without counting an attempt. Returns
    ``(decision, created)``; replaying the same key with the same job
    and moment returns the current decision with ``False`` without
    writing, while the same key with a different action, job or moment
    raises ``ValueError``.

    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; a missing dispatch ledger
    raises ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid ledger structure, values,
    ordering, references or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
    """
    for value in (ledger, job_id, key):
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
            raise ValueError("ledger, job_id and key must be non-empty "
                             "strings")
    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")

    store = _get_store(ledger)
    with store.lock:
        with _lock(store.realpath):
            decisions, idempotency, events, old_bytes = \
                _load_existing_ledger(store.realpath)

            request = _request("recover", job_id, at)
            replayed = _replay(decisions, idempotency, key, request)
            if replayed is not None:
                return replayed

            decision = decisions.get(job_id)
            if decision is None:
                raise KeyError(job_id)
            if decision["state"] != "claimed":
                raise ValueError("decision is not claimed")
            if at <= decision["lease_end"]:
                raise PermissionError("the lease has not expired yet")

            decision["state"] = "ready"
            decision["owner"] = None
            decision["lease_end"] = None
            idempotency[key] = request
            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request,
                           "result": copy.deepcopy(decision)}
            _commit_file(store.realpath,
                         _canonical_bytes(decisions, idempotency, events),
                         old_bytes)

69	def _validate_ledger(
70	    data: object,
71	    job_ids: dict[str, Any],
72	    resource_ids: dict[str, Any],
73	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, str]], dict[str, str]]:
74	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_ROOT_FIELDS):
75	        raise ValueError("ledger root must be an object with keys "
76	                         "version, matches and idempotency")
77	
78	    version = data["version"]
79	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version != _VERSION:
80	        raise ValueError("unsupported ledger version")
81	
82	    matches_raw = data["matches"]
83	    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
84	    if not isinstance(matches_raw, dict) or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict):
85	        raise ValueError("matches and idempotency must be objects")
86	
87	    matches: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
88	    for name, record in matches_raw.items():
89	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
90	            raise ValueError("job ids must be non-empty strings")
91	        if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record.keys()) != set(_MATCH_FIELDS):
92	            raise ValueError("match record has invalid fields")
93	        if record["job_id"] != name:
94	            raise ValueError("match record id does not match its key")
95	        resource_id = record["resource_id"]
96	        if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
97	            raise ValueError("resource_id must be a non-empty string")
98	        if name not in job_ids:
99	            raise ValueError("match record must reference a registered job")
100	        if resource_id not in resource_ids:
101	            raise ValueError("match record must reference a registered offer")
102	        matches[name] = {"job_id": name, "resource_id": resource_id}
103	
104	    idempotency: dict[str, str] = {}
105	    referenced: set[str] = set()
106	    for key, job_id in idempotency_raw.items():
107	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
108	            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
109	        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id or job_id not in matches:
110	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded match")
111	        if job_id in referenced:
112	            raise ValueError("job matched under more than one idempotency key")
113	        referenced.add(job_id)
114	        idempotency[key] = job_id
115	
116	    return matches, idempotency

137	def _atomic_write(
138	    realpath: str,
139	    matches: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
140	    idempotency: dict[str, str],
141	) -> None:
142	    payload = {
143	        "version": _VERSION,
144	        "matches": {name: matches[name] for name in sorted(matches)},
145	        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key] for key in sorted(idempotency)},
146	    }
147	    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
148	                      allow_nan=False) + "\n"
149	
150	    directory = os.path.dirname(realpath) or "."
151	    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=directory, prefix=".ledger-",
152	                                    suffix=".tmp")
153	    try:
154	        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
155	            handle.write(text)
156	            handle.flush()
157	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
158	        os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
159	    except BaseException:
160	        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
161	            os.unlink(tmp_path)
162	        raise
163	
164	    dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
165	    try:
166	        os.fsync(dir_fd)
167	    finally:
168	        os.close(dir_fd)

171	def match(
172	    jobs: str,
173	    offers: str,
174	    ledger: str,
175	    job_id: str,
176	    key: str,
177	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
178	    """Match a registered job to the greenest feasible offer idempotently.
179	
180	    Candidates are offers whose region is permitted by the job's
181	    residency_regions and whose remaining capacity (capacity_wh minus the
182	    energy already allocated in the ledger) covers the job's energy_wh;
183	    the winner is the first by ascending carbon_intensity, unit_cost and
184	    resource_id. Returns ``(record, created)`` where ``record`` carries
185	    job_id and resource_id; ``created`` is ``True`` for a new match and
186	    ``False`` when the idempotency key replays a match for the same job
187	    (which allocates no further capacity).
188	    """
189	    for value in (jobs, offers, ledger, job_id, key):
190	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
191	            raise ValueError("jobs, offers, ledger, job_id and key must be "
192	                             "non-empty strings")
193	
194	    store = _get_store(ledger)
195	    with store.lock:
196	        job_records, _ = _load_registry(
197	            os.path.realpath(jobs), _jobs._validate_structure, "jobs registry")
198	        if job_id not in job_records:
199	            raise KeyError(job_id)
200	        job = job_records[job_id]
201	
202	        offer_records, _ = _load_registry(
203	            os.path.realpath(offers), _offers._validate_structure,
204	            "offers registry")
205	        matches, idempotency = _load_ledger(
206	            store.realpath, job_records, offer_records)
207	
208	        existing = idempotency.get(key)
209	        if existing is not None:
210	            if existing != job_id:
211	                raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used with a "
212	                                 "different job")
213	            return dict(matches[job_id]), False
214	        if job_id in matches:
215	            raise ValueError("job is already matched under another "
216	                             "idempotency key")
217	
218	        allocated: dict[str, int] = {}
219	        for record in matches.values():
220	            resource_id = record["resource_id"]
221	            allocated[resource_id] = (
222	                allocated.get(resource_id, 0)
223	                + job_records[record["job_id"]]["energy_wh"])
224	
225	        allowed = set(job["residency_regions"])
226	        needed = job["energy_wh"]
227	        best: tuple[int, int, str] | None = None
228	        for resource_id, offer in offer_records.items():
229	            if offer["region"] not in allowed:
230	                continue
231	            if offer["capacity_wh"] - allocated.get(resource_id, 0) < needed:
232	                continue
233	            candidate = (offer["carbon_intensity"], offer["unit_cost"],
234	                         resource_id)
235	            if best is None or candidate < best:
236	                best = candidate
237	        if best is None:
238	            raise LookupError("no feasible offer for job")
239	
240	        record = {"job_id": job_id, "resource_id": best[2]}
241	        matches[job_id] = record
242	        idempotency[key] = job_id
243	        _atomic_write(store.realpath, matches, idempotency)
244	        return dict(record), True

263	@contextlib.contextmanager
264	def _clear_lock(realpath: str, *, shared: bool = False) -> Iterator[None]:
265	    # As in resources.jobs, the companion lock file is never unlinked and
266	    # an flock is released by the kernel on process exit, so equivalent
267	    # real paths share one lock across threads and processes.
268	    lock_path = realpath + _LOCK_SUFFIX
269	    fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR, 0o666)
270	    try:
271	        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_SH if shared else fcntl.LOCK_EX)
272	        try:
273	            yield
274	        finally:
275	            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
276	    finally:
277	        os.close(fd)

286	def _validate_signal(
287	    signal: object,
288	    resource_region: str,
289	    at: int,
290	    signal_history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] | None,
291	) -> tuple[int, int]:
292	    # Returns the binary numeric pair (unit_cost, carbon_intensity) the
293	    # caller prices on, never the signal record itself. A live candidate
294	    # freezes the exact published signal record -- region, version and
295	    # all observations -- so a later signal publish cannot change what an
296	    # earlier trade was decided under. When the
297	    # signal snapshot is available (clear_live), the frozen record must
298	    # be the exact published version. Readers that never take the signal
299	    # file (static clear, dispatch, execution) still validate the frozen
300	    # record structurally and arithmetically: its totals, window and
301	    # budget relations are all decidable from the frozen bytes, so their
302	    # invariants hold without resolving the reference.
303	    if not isinstance(signal, dict) \
304	            or set(signal.keys()) != set(_signals._RECORD_FIELDS):
305	        raise ValueError("trade candidate signal has invalid fields")
306	    region = signal["region"]
307	    version = signal["version"]
308	    if region != resource_region:
309	        raise ValueError("trade candidate signal must cover the resource "
310	                         "region")
311	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version < 1:
312	        raise ValueError("candidate signal version must be a positive "
313	                         "integer")
314	    # Validate a copy: _check_values normalizes the mix order in place,
315	    # and the parsed record's raw key order must be left untouched so the
316	    # ledger's canonical-byte comparison still rejects a reordered mix.
317	    signal_copy = dict(signal)
318	    signal_copy["mix"] = dict(signal["mix"])
319	    _signals._check_values(signal_copy)
320	    if signal_history is not None:
321	        records = signal_history.get(region)
322	        if records is None or version > len(records) \
323	                or dict(signal) != records[version - 1]:
324	            raise ValueError("trade candidate signal must reference a "
325	                             "published signal version")
326	    if not (signal["observed"] <= at <= signal["expires"]):
327	        raise ValueError("trade candidate signal must be valid at the "
328	                         "trade's evaluation moment")
329	    return signal["unit_cost"], signal["carbon_intensity"]

332	def _validate_candidate(
333	    entry: object,
334	    work: int,
335	    at: int,
336	    job: dict[str, Any],
337	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
338	    signal_history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] | None,
339	    seen: set[str],
340	) -> tuple[bool, int, int, str]:
341	    if not isinstance(entry, dict) \
342	            or set(entry.keys()) not in (set(_STATIC_CANDIDATE_FIELDS),
343	                                         set(_LIVE_CANDIDATE_FIELDS)):
344	        raise ValueError("trade candidate has invalid fields")
345	    live = "signal" in entry
346	    resource = entry["resource"]
347	    if not isinstance(resource, dict) \
348	            or set(resource.keys()) != set(_resources._RECORD_FIELDS):
349	        raise ValueError("trade candidate resource has invalid fields")
350	    # Strict value typing (booleans rejected), the same rules a
351	    # published version had to satisfy.
352	    _resources._check_values(resource)
353	    resource_id = resource["resource_id"]
354	    version = resource["version"]
355	    if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
356	        raise ValueError("candidate resource_id must be a non-empty string")
357	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version < 1:
358	        raise ValueError("candidate version must be a positive integer")
359	    # The versioned record must be the exact, immutable supply record.
360	    records = history.get(resource_id)
361	    if records is None or version > len(records) \
362	            or dict(resource) != records[version - 1]:
363	        raise ValueError("trade candidate must reference a published "
364	                         "resource version")
365	    if resource_id in seen:
366	        raise ValueError("trade candidates must be distinct resources")
367	    seen.add(resource_id)
368	    if not (resource["start"] <= at <= resource["end"]):
369	        raise ValueError("trade candidate must be valid at the trade's "
370	                         "evaluation moment")
371	    # Static trades price on the version's baked-in figures; live trades
372	    # price on the frozen signal for the same region.
373	    if live:
374	        unit_cost, carbon_intensity = _validate_signal(
375	            entry["signal"], resource["region"], at, signal_history)
376	    else:
377	        unit_cost = resource["unit_cost"]
378	        carbon_intensity = resource["carbon_intensity"]
379	    total_cost = entry["total_cost"]
380	    total_carbon = entry["total_carbon"]
381	    if not _is_plain_int(total_cost) or total_cost < 0 \
382	            or total_cost != work * unit_cost:
383	        raise ValueError("trade candidate total_cost is invalid")
384	    if not _is_plain_int(total_carbon) or total_carbon < 0 \
385	            or total_carbon != work * carbon_intensity:
386	        raise ValueError("trade candidate total_carbon is invalid")
387	    # The snapshot must still describe the same feasibility the trade
388	    # was decided under; published versions and accepted jobs never
389	    # change, so a valid trade stays valid forever.
390	    if resource["region"] not in set(job["regions"]):
391	        raise ValueError("trade candidate is outside the job's regions")
392	    if not set(job["residency"]) <= set(resource["residency"]):
393	        raise ValueError("trade candidate does not cover job residency")
394	    if resource["end"] < job["deadline"]:
395	        raise ValueError("trade candidate does not cover the job deadline")
396	    if total_cost > job["max_cost"] \
397	            or total_carbon > job["carbon_cap"]:
398	        raise ValueError("trade candidate exceeds a job budget")
399	    return live, carbon_intensity, unit_cost, resource_id

402	def _validate_trade(
403	    record: object,
404	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
405	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
406	    signal_history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] | None,
407	) -> dict[str, Any]:
408	    if not isinstance(record, dict) \
409	            or set(record.keys()) != set(_TRADE_FIELDS):
410	        raise ValueError("trade record has invalid fields")
411	    job_id = record["job_id"]
412	    at = record["at"]
413	    work = record["work"]
414	    resource_id = record["resource_id"]
415	    version = record["version"]
416	    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
417	        raise ValueError("trade job_id must be a non-empty string")
418	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
419	        raise ValueError("trade at must be a non-boolean non-negative "
420	                         "integer")
421	    if not _is_plain_int(work) or work <= 0:
422	        raise ValueError("trade work must be a positive integer")
423	    if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
424	        raise ValueError("trade resource_id must be a non-empty string")
425	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version < 1:
426	        raise ValueError("trade version must be a positive integer")
427	    selection = record["selection"]
428	    if not isinstance(selection, dict) \
429	            or set(selection.keys()) != set(_SELECTION_FIELDS):
430	        raise ValueError("trade selection has invalid fields")
431	    if selection["resource_id"] != resource_id \
432	            or not isinstance(selection["resource_id"], str):
433	        raise ValueError("trade selection does not name its resource")
434	    if selection["version"] != version:
435	        raise ValueError("trade selection does not name its version")
436	
437	    job = accepted.get(job_id)
438	    if job is None:
439	        raise ValueError("trade must reference an accepted job")
440	    if work != job["work"]:
441	        raise ValueError("trade work does not match its accepted job")
442	    records = history.get(resource_id)
443	    if records is None or version > len(records):
444	        raise ValueError("trade must reference a published resource version")
445	
446	    candidates_raw = record["candidates"]
447	    if not isinstance(candidates_raw, list) or not candidates_raw:
448	        raise ValueError("trade candidates must be a non-empty list")
449	    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
450	    last_rank: tuple[int, int, str] | None = None
451	    seen: set[str] = set()
452	    live_kind: bool | None = None
453	    for entry_raw in candidates_raw:
454	        live, carbon, unit_cost, candidate_id = _validate_candidate(
455	            entry_raw, work, at, job, history, signal_history, seen)
456	        # A trade is decided under exactly one pricing mode: static
457	        # trades never carry a signal, live trades always carry one.
458	        if live_kind is None:
459	            live_kind = live
460	        elif live != live_kind:
461	            raise ValueError("trade candidates must all be static or all "
462	                             "live")
463	        rank = (carbon, unit_cost, candidate_id)
464	        if last_rank is not None and rank < last_rank:
465	            raise ValueError("trade candidates must be ordered by carbon "
466	                             "intensity, unit cost and resource id")
467	        last_rank = rank
468	        # Keep the parsed key order: the candidate's resource must equal
469	        # the supply record field-for-field and its frozen signal -- when
470	        # resolvable -- the published signal, while the ledger's
471	        # canonical-byte comparison rejects any reordered nested object.
472	        candidates.append(copy.deepcopy(entry_raw))
473	
474	    # The first ordered candidate is the unique winner.
475	    winner = candidates[0]["resource"]
476	    if winner["resource_id"] != resource_id or winner["version"] != version:
477	        raise ValueError("trade selection must be the first ordered "
478	                         "candidate")
479	    return {
480	        "job_id": job_id,
481	        "at": at,
482	        "work": work,
483	        "resource_id": resource_id,
484	        "version": version,
485	        "candidates": candidates,
486	        "selection": {"resource_id": resource_id, "version": version},
487	    }

492	    # root shape, which is distinct from every other ledger's (the
493	    # settlement root carries "records" where this carries
494	    # "completions").

496	        ("version", "completions", "idempotency", "audit"))

499	def _discover_completion_paths(anchor_reals: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
500	    # Scan each anchor directory once for completion ledgers. Malformed
501	    # or unrelated siblings are ignored; a sibling with the completion
502	    # root shape that fails full validation is still returned and the
503	    # full loader rejects it.
504	    found: list[str] = []
505	    seen_dirs: set[str] = set()
506	    for anchor in anchor_reals:
507	        directory = os.path.dirname(anchor) or "."
508	        if directory in seen_dirs:
509	            continue
510	        seen_dirs.add(directory)
511	        try:
512	            names = os.listdir(directory)
513	        except OSError:
514	            continue
515	        for name in names:
516	            if not name.endswith(".json"):
517	                continue
518	            real = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(directory, name))
519	            if real in found or real in set(anchor_reals):
520	                continue
521	            try:
522	                with open(real, "rb") as handle:
523	                    raw = handle.read()
524	                data = finite_loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
525	            except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
526	                continue
527	            if _completion_root_shape(data):
528	                found.append(real)
529	    found.sort()
530	    return found

533	def _load_completion_union(
534	    paths: list[str],
535	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
536	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
537	) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
538	    # The union of completion records across the explicit ledger and the
539	    # ledgers discovered beside the snapshots, keyed by job id. Ledgers
540	    # are fully validated against the same acceptance and supply
541	    # snapshots; a malformed completion ledger raises just like any
542	    # other malformed business ledger.
543	    from . import completion as _completion
544	    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
545	    for real in paths:
546	        ledger_records, _ids, _events, raw = \
547	            _completion._load_completion_ledger(real, accepted, history)
548	        if raw is None:
549	            raise FileNotFoundError(
550	                f"completion ledger {real!r} does not exist")
551	        for record in ledger_records.values():
552	            prior = records.get(record["job_id"])
553	            if prior is not None and prior != record:
554	                raise ValueError(
555	                    "a job is completed differently in two completion "
556	                    "ledgers")
557	            records.setdefault(record["job_id"], record)

561	def _completion_capacity_envelope(
562	    trades: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
563	    completed: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
564	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
565	) -> None:
566	    # Replay every capacity-changing event per exact resource version:
567	    # a trade books its work at its evaluation moment, and the job's
568	    # completion releases that traded occupancy again at the completion
569	    # moment regardless of its migration history -- completion is the
570	    # terminal event, after which a job occupies nothing. Releasing at
571	    # the completion moment is conservative for jobs that migrated away
572	    # earlier (their source frees at the switch, which this trades-only
573	    # view cannot see): reuse between switch and completion stays
574	    # counted, reuse from the completion moment on is accepted. Releases
575	    # are applied before bookings at the same moment, since releases
576	    # effective "not later than" that moment free the capacity. Capacity
577	    # must never be oversold at any booking moment.
578	    def capacity_of(slot: tuple[str, int]) -> int:
579	        resource_id, version = slot
580	        return history[resource_id][version - 1]["capacity"]
581	
582	    events: dict[tuple[str, int], list[tuple[int, int, int]]] = {}
583	    for job_id, trade in trades.items():
584	        slot = (trade["resource_id"], trade["version"])
585	        events.setdefault(slot, []).append(
586	            (trade["at"], 1, trade["work"]))
587	        record = completed.get(job_id)
588	        if record is not None:
589	            events.setdefault(slot, []).append(
590	                (record["at"], 0, trade["work"]))
591	    for slot, slot_events in events.items():
592	        running = 0
593	        # Releases (kind 0) before bookings (kind 1) at the same moment.
594	        for at, kind, work in sorted(slot_events):
595	            if kind == 0:
596	                running -= work
597	                if running < 0:
598	                    raise ValueError(
599	                        "completion releases capacity a trade never booked")
600	            else:
601	                running += work
602	                if running > capacity_of(slot):
603	                    raise ValueError(
604	                        "ledger oversells a published resource version")
605
