607	def _validate_clear_ledger(
608	    data: object,
609	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
610	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
611	    signal_history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] | None = None,
612	    completed: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
613	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
614	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_CLEAR_ROOT_FIELDS):
615	        raise ValueError("clearing ledger root must be an object with keys "
616	                         "version, trades, idempotency and audit")
617	    version = data["version"]
618	    if not _is_plain_int(version) or version != _CLEAR_VERSION:
619	        raise ValueError("unsupported clearing ledger version")
620	
621	    trades_raw = data["trades"]
622	    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
623	    audit_raw = data["audit"]
624	    if not isinstance(trades_raw, dict) \
625	            or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict) \
626	            or not isinstance(audit_raw, dict):
627	        raise ValueError("trades, idempotency and audit must be objects")
628	    _check_sorted_keys(trades_raw, "trades")
629	    _check_sorted_keys(idempotency_raw, "idempotency")
630	    _check_sorted_keys(audit_raw, "audit")
631	
632	    trades: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
633	    for job_id, record in trades_raw.items():
634	        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
635	            raise ValueError("trade job ids must be non-empty strings")
636	        trade = _validate_trade(record, accepted, history, signal_history)
637	        if trade["job_id"] != job_id:
638	            raise ValueError("trade record id does not match its key")
639	        trades[job_id] = trade
640	
641	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
642	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
643	    referenced: set[str] = set()
644	    for key, binding in idempotency_raw.items():
645	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
646	            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
647	        if not isinstance(binding, dict) \
648	                or set(binding.keys()) != {"job_id", "at"}:
649	            raise ValueError("idempotency binding has invalid fields")
650	        bound_job = binding["job_id"]
651	        bound_at = binding["at"]
652	        if not isinstance(bound_job, str) or not bound_job \
653	                or bound_job not in trades:
654	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded "
655	                             "trade")
656	        if not _is_plain_int(bound_at) or bound_at < 0:
657	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must bind an evaluation "
658	                             "moment")
659	        if bound_job in referenced:
660	            raise ValueError("job traded under more than one idempotency "
661	                             "key")
662	        referenced.add(bound_job)
663	        trade = trades[bound_job]
664	        if trade["at"] != bound_at:
665	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry does not match its trade")
666	        idempotency[key] = {"job_id": bound_job, "at": bound_at}
667	
668	    for key, event in audit_raw.items():
669	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
670	            raise ValueError("audit keys must be non-empty strings")
671	        if not isinstance(event, dict) \
672	                or set(event.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
673	            raise ValueError("clear audit event has invalid fields")
674	        event_key = event["key"]
675	        job_id = event["job_id"]
676	        at = event["at"]
677	        resource_id = event["resource_id"]
678	        event_version = event["version"]
679	        if event_key != key or not isinstance(event_key, str) or not event_key:
680	            raise ValueError("audit event key does not match its map key")
681	        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id or job_id not in trades:
682	            raise ValueError("audit event must reference a recorded trade")
683	        if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
684	            raise ValueError("audit event at must be a non-negative integer")
685	        if not isinstance(resource_id, str) or not resource_id:
686	            raise ValueError("audit event resource_id must be a non-empty "
687	                             "string")
688	        if not _is_plain_int(event_version) or event_version < 1:
689	            raise ValueError("audit event version must be a positive integer")
690	        trade = trades[job_id]
691	        if at != trade["at"] or resource_id != trade["resource_id"] \
692	                or event_version != trade["version"]:
693	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its trade")
694	        events[key] = {"key": event_key, "job_id": job_id, "at": at,
695	                       "resource_id": resource_id, "version": event_version}
696	
697	    # The three sections describe one clearing history: each idempotency
698	    # key binds one trade and one event, and each trade is bound exactly
699	    # once.
700	    if set(idempotency) != set(events):
701	        raise ValueError("idempotency keys and audit events do not match")
702	    for key, binding in idempotency.items():
703	        event = events[key]
704	        if event["job_id"] != binding["job_id"] or event["at"] != binding["at"]:
705	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its idempotency "
706	                             "entry")
707	    if set(trades) != referenced:
708	        raise ValueError("every trade must be bound to an idempotency key")
709	
710	    # Recorded bookings may not oversell any published version at any
711	    # moment. Without a completion snapshot the historical aggregate is
712	    # the same as before; with one, releases complete bookings opened
713	    # and only the running envelope must stay within capacity.
714	    if completed:
715	        _completion_capacity_envelope(trades, completed, history)
716	    else:
717	        booked: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
718	        for trade in trades.values():
719	            slot = (trade["resource_id"], trade["version"])
720	            booked[slot] = booked.get(slot, 0) + trade["work"]
721	        for (resource_id, version), amount in booked.items():
722	            record = history[resource_id][version - 1]
723	            if record["capacity"] < amount:
724	                raise ValueError(
725	                    "ledger oversells a published resource version")
726	
727	    return trades, idempotency

730	def _canonical_clear_bytes(
731	    trades: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
732	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
733	) -> bytes:
734	    audit = {key: {
735	        "key": key,
736	        "job_id": trades[binding["job_id"]]["job_id"],
737	        "at": binding["at"],
738	        "resource_id": trades[binding["job_id"]]["resource_id"],
739	        "version": trades[binding["job_id"]]["version"],
740	    } for key, binding in idempotency.items()}
741	    payload = {
742	        "version": _CLEAR_VERSION,
743	        "trades": {job_id: trades[job_id] for job_id in sorted(trades)},
744	        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key] for key in sorted(idempotency)},
745	        "audit": {key: audit[key] for key in sorted(audit)},
746	    }
747	    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
748	                      allow_nan=False) + "\n"
749	    return text.encode("utf-8")

752	def _load_clear_ledger(
753	    realpath: str,
754	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
755	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
756	    signal_history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] | None = None,
757	    completion_paths: list[str] | None = None,
758	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]], bytes | None]:
759	    try:
760	        with open(realpath, "rb") as handle:
761	            raw = handle.read()
762	    except FileNotFoundError:
763	        return {}, {}, None
764	    try:
765	        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
766	    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
767	        raise ValueError(
768	            f"clearing ledger {realpath!r} is not valid UTF-8") from exc
769	    try:
770	        # Negative-zero and non-finite literals are format errors.
771	        data = finite_loads(text)
772	    except ValueError as exc:
773	        raise ValueError(
774	            f"clearing ledger {realpath!r} is not valid JSON") from exc
775	    # Completions open booked capacity again. The completion paths to
776	    # observe are supplied by the caller, which discovers siblings
777	    # *before* taking its locks and shares every completion lock in the
778	    # one global resolved-path order, so a concurrent completion that
779	    # holds the completion lock exclusively can never deadlock against
780	    # this read. The running-envelope check then accepts a trades ledger
781	    # whose capacity was legitimately reused after a completion.
782	    completed = _load_completion_union(
783	        completion_paths or (), accepted, history)
784	    trades, idempotency = _validate_clear_ledger(
785	        data, accepted, history, signal_history, completed)
786	    # As for the supply file, the ledger is accepted only in canonical
787	    # compact form with a single trailing newline.
788	    if raw != _canonical_clear_bytes(trades, idempotency):
789	        raise ValueError(
790	            f"clearing ledger {realpath!r} is not in canonical compact form")
791	    return trades, idempotency, raw

802	def _rollback_clear(realpath: str, directory: str, old_bytes: bytes | None,
803	                    first: BaseException) -> None:
804	    # Restore the exact pre-call bytes while the exclusive lock is held,
805	    # or remove a ledger that did not exist beforehand, then sync the
806	    # directory. A failed recovery chains after the original error.
807	    try:
808	        if old_bytes is None:
809	            try:
810	                os.unlink(realpath)
811	            except FileNotFoundError:
812	                pass
813	        else:
814	            fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
815	                dir=directory, prefix=".clear-restore-", suffix=".tmp")
816	            try:
817	                with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
818	                    handle.write(old_bytes)
819	                    handle.flush()
820	                    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
821	                os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
822	            except BaseException:
823	                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
824	                    os.unlink(tmp_path)
825	                raise
826	        _fsync_directory(directory)
827	    except OSError as recovery:
828	        raise recovery from first

831	def _commit_clear(realpath: str, payload: bytes,
832	                  old_bytes: bytes | None) -> None:
833	    # One durable commit for the trade, the idempotency binding and the
834	    # audit event: synced same-directory temporary, atomic replace and a
835	    # directory fsync, restoring the pre-call bytes on any failure.
836	    directory = os.path.dirname(realpath) or "."
837	    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
838	        dir=directory, prefix=".clear-", suffix=".tmp")
839	    try:
840	        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
841	            handle.write(payload)
842	            handle.flush()
843	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
844	        os.replace(tmp_path, realpath)
845	    except BaseException:
846	        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
847	            os.unlink(tmp_path)
848	        raise
849	    try:
850	        _fsync_directory(directory)
851	    except BaseException as first:
852	        _rollback_clear(realpath, directory, old_bytes, first)
853	        raise

856	def clear(
857	    jobs: str,
858	    supply: str,
859	    ledger: str,
860	    job_id: str,
861	    key: str,
862	    at: int,
863	    completions: str | None = None,
864	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
865	    """Clear one accepted job against the versioned supply idempotently.
866	
867	    ``jobs``, ``supply`` and ``ledger`` paths, ``job_id`` and ``key``
868	    must be non-empty strings and ``at`` a non-boolean non-negative
869	    integer evaluation moment; the three paths must also resolve to
870	    distinct real locations. Any violation raises ``ValueError`` before
871	    a business file is read.
872	
873	    The ``jobs.submit`` acceptance file and the resource supply file are
874	    read as one snapshot under their shared locks together with the
875	    ledger's exclusive lock, all three taken in resolved real-path
876	    order. Only each resource's highest version valid at ``at`` is
877	    considered, and feasibility -- region, residency, cost and carbon
878	    budgets, deadline coverage and the candidate entries -- follows
879	    :func:`resources.feasible`. A version's capacity is additionally
880	    reduced by the work of every trade already booked against that exact
881	    resource version in the ledger, so capacity is never oversold and
882	    bookings never cross versions. Remaining candidates are ordered by
883	    carbon intensity, unit cost and resource id; the first is the unique
884	    winner.
885	
886	    Returns ``(trade, created)``; the trade binds the job, the
887	    evaluation moment, the work, the ordered candidate snapshot and a
888	    versioned selection. A missing ledger is created only on the first
889	    trade, the trade, its idempotency binding and the audit event
890	    binding the key, resource id and version committed in one synced
891	    atomic write. Replaying the same key with the same job and
892	    evaluation moment returns the stored trade with ``False`` without
893	    reselecting, appending or rewriting. The same key with a different
894	    request, or a job already traded under another key, raises
895	    ``ValueError`` with the ledger untouched.
896	
897	    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; no remaining feasible resource
898	    raises ``LookupError``; neither creates the ledger. Missing input
899	    files or a missing ledger parent raise ``FileNotFoundError`` without
900	    leaving a ledger or temporary fragment. Invalid structure,
901	    references, ordering or canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
902	    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
903	    """
904	    for value in (jobs, supply, ledger, job_id, key):
905	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
906	            raise ValueError("jobs, supply, ledger, job_id and key must be "
907	                             "non-empty strings")
908	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
909	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
910	    if completions is not None and (
911	            not isinstance(completions, str) or not completions):
912	        raise ValueError("completions must be a non-empty string or None")
913	
914	    job_real = os.path.realpath(jobs)
915	    supply_real = os.path.realpath(supply)
916	    ledger_real = os.path.realpath(ledger)
917	    business_paths = {job_real, supply_real, ledger_real}
918	    completion_real = (os.path.realpath(completions)
919	                       if completions is not None else None)
920	    if completion_real is not None and completion_real in business_paths:
921	        raise ValueError("completions must be a distinct real path")
922	    # Completion ledgers beside the snapshots are part of the physical
923	    # ledger state and must be locked in the same global order; they are
924	    # discovered before any lock is taken, so a concurrent completion
925	    # can never deadlock against this clearing.
926	    completion_paths = _discover_completion_paths(
927	        (job_real, supply_real, ledger_real))
928	    if completion_real is not None and completion_real \
929	            not in completion_paths:
930	        completion_paths.append(completion_real)
931	    locked_paths = business_paths | set(completion_paths)
932	    if len({job_real, supply_real, ledger_real}) != 3:
933	        raise ValueError("jobs, supply and ledger paths must be distinct "
934	                         "real paths")
935	
936	    store = _get_store(ledger)
937	    with store.lock:
938	        # Locks are taken in one resolved-real-path order shared by
939	        # every caller, so concurrent clears can never deadlock; the
940	        # ledger lock is exclusive, every other lock shared.
941	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
942	            for locked in sorted(locked_paths):
943	                stack.enter_context(
944	                    _clear_lock(locked, shared=(locked != ledger_real)))
945	
946	            accepted, job_map, job_events, job_raw = \
947	                _jobs._load_submit_file(job_real)
948	            if job_raw is None:
949	                raise FileNotFoundError(
950	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
951	            # Like the supply file and the ledger, the acceptance
952	            # snapshot must be in the canonical compact form jobs.submit
953	            # writes; this does not change resources.feasible, which keeps
954	            # its own documented read behavior.
955	            if job_raw != _jobs._serialize_submit_file(
956	                    accepted, job_map, job_events):
957	                raise ValueError(
958	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} is not in canonical "
959	                    "compact form")
960	            history, _supply_map, _supply_events, supply_raw = \
961	                _resources._load_file(supply_real)
962	            if supply_raw is None:
963	                raise FileNotFoundError(
964	                    f"supply file {supply_real!r} does not exist")
965	            # The union is read under the shared completion locks as one
966	            # snapshot. Releases affect the decision only when a
967	            # completion ledger was explicitly provided: omitting the
968	            # argument keeps the historical result (every trade still
969	            # occupies its booked version), while the envelope check
970	            # below still accepts capacity legitimately reused through a
971	            # completion ledger that lives beside the trades ledger.
972	            completion_union = _load_completion_union(
973	                completion_paths, accepted, history) \
974	                if completion_paths else {}
975	            released_jobs: set[str] = set()
976	            if completion_real is not None:
977	                released_jobs = {
978	                    job for job, record in completion_union.items()
979	                    if record["at"] <= at}
980	            trades, idempotency, old_bytes = _load_clear_ledger(
981	                ledger_real, accepted, history,
982	                completion_paths=completion_paths)
983	
984	            job = accepted.get(job_id)
985	            if job is None:
986	                raise KeyError(job_id)
987	
988	            binding = idempotency.get(key)
989	            if binding is not None:
990	                if binding["job_id"] != job_id or binding["at"] != at:
991	                    raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used with "
992	                                     "a different request")
993	                return copy.deepcopy(trades[job_id]), False
994	            if job_id in trades:
995	                raise ValueError("job is already traded under another "
996	                                 "idempotency key")
997	
998	            # Capacity already sold per exact resource version; replays
999	            # never re-enter this path, so every recorded trade counts
1000	            # exactly once and bookings never cross versions. A job
1001	            # whose completion is already effective at the evaluation
1002	            # moment has released its booked occupancy, so its trade no
1003	            # longer deducts capacity.
1004	            sold: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
1005	            for traded_job, trade in trades.items():
1006	                if traded_job in released_jobs:
1007	                    continue
1008	                slot = (trade["resource_id"], trade["version"])
1009	                sold[slot] = sold.get(slot, 0) + trade["work"]
1010	
1011	            work = job["work"]
1012	            regions = set(job["regions"])
1013	            residency = set(job["residency"])
1014	            candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1015	            for records in history.values():
1016	                active: dict[str, Any] | None = None
1017	                for record in records:
1018	                    if record["start"] <= at <= record["end"]:
1019	                        active = record
1020	                if active is None:
1021	                    continue
1022	                if active["region"] not in regions:
1023	                    continue
1024	                remaining = active["capacity"] - sold.get(
1025	                    (active["resource_id"], active["version"]), 0)
1026	                if remaining < work:
1027	                    continue
1028	                if not residency <= set(active["residency"]):
1029	                    continue
1030	                if active["end"] < job["deadline"]:
1031	                    continue
1032	                total_cost = work * active["unit_cost"]
1033	                total_carbon = work * active["carbon_intensity"]
1034	                if total_cost > job["max_cost"] \
1035	                        or total_carbon > job["carbon_cap"]:
1036	                    continue
1037	                candidates.append({
1038	                    "resource": dict(active),
1039	                    "total_cost": total_cost,
1040	                    "total_carbon": total_carbon,
1041	                })
1042	
1043	            candidates.sort(key=lambda entry: (
1044	                entry["resource"]["carbon_intensity"],
1045	                entry["resource"]["unit_cost"],
1046	                entry["resource"]["resource_id"]))
1047	            if not candidates:
1048	                raise LookupError("no remaining feasible resource for job")
1049	
1050	            winner = candidates[0]["resource"]
1051	            resource_id = winner["resource_id"]
1052	            version = winner["version"]
1053	            trade: dict[str, Any] = {
1054	                "job_id": job_id,
1055	                "at": at,
1056	                "work": work,
1057	                "resource_id": resource_id,
1058	                "version": version,
1059	                "candidates": candidates,
1060	                "selection": {"resource_id": resource_id,
1061	                              "version": version},
1062	            }
1063	            trades[job_id] = trade
1064	            idempotency[key] = {"job_id": job_id, "at": at}
1065	            _commit_clear(ledger_real,
1066	                          _canonical_clear_bytes(trades, idempotency),
1067	                          old_bytes)
1068	            return copy.deepcopy(trade), True
